title: Jira story input
description: Optional structured input for crv-create-jira-story. A caller that already has stories in machine-readable form can pass this instead of describing them in prose. The conversational path enforces the same rules.

summary.description: The story title. Jira rejects summaries over 255 characters, so the bound is enforced here rather than discovered at create time.

parent.description: Key of the parent Epic, for example ABC-123.

story_points.description: Estimate. Required: an un-estimated story is the failure this skill exists to prevent. Deliberately not restricted to a Fibonacci sequence -- teams use their own scales, and a roll-up of several items lands on no ladder at all.

project_key.description: Overrides the recorded default project. Omit to file into the parent Epic's project.

issue_type.description: Issue type name as it appears on the project's create screen.

description_markdown.description: A fully rendered description. When present it is used as-is and the structured fields below are ignored.

additional_fields.description: Extra fields, keyed by their human-readable Jira name rather than a customfield_NNNNN identifier. The skill resolves names to identifiers from the project's create-metadata at run time, because identifiers differ per tenant and change when an administrator edits a screen.
